result.title: SPARC: Semantic Calibration with Latent Multimodal Knowledge for Robust Image-Text Retrieval
result.summary: Robust image-text retrieval aims to maintain accurate cross-modal matching when image or text queries are incomplete, supporting reliable information access in real-world applications. However, existing methods typically focus on adapting to distribution shifts, without adequately addressing candidate discrimination for incomplete queries and ranking instability. To this end, we propose semantic projection and alignment with relational constraints (SPARC), which elicits latent multimodal knowledge from frozen encoders to improve candidate discrimination and ranking stability. Specifically, we first devise a semantic calibration module on a product of spheres that refines incomplete visual and textual features through tangent-space updates, maintaining the unit-sphere structure used for cosine similarity. Second, we introduce a robust semantic guidance module that combines latent multimodal knowledge encoded in complete image-text features with cross-modal semantic anchors to promote semantic alignment of the calibrated features. Finally, we introduce a matching relation constraint module that fuses original query features with their calibrated counterparts and applies a soft ranking constraint to penalize reductions in initially positive matching margins, thereby limiting ranking perturbations. Extensive experiments on Flickr30K and COCO demonstrate that SPARC outperforms competing methods under various image occlusion and word deletion settings, while achieving consistent gains across different pretrained backbones.

AI.brief_summary: 论文面向图像或文本查询不完整时的鲁棒图文检索，提出 SPARC：在球面流形上以切空间更新校准不完整特征，借助冻结编码器中的完整图文特征与跨模态语义锚点做语义对齐，并用软排序约束抑制匹配边界的扰动。
AI.relevance_reason: 其球面切空间特征更新与保持余弦结构的校准思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的迭代更新与相似度几何提供核查线索；软排序约束也可对照 latent 证据筛选与排序稳定性问题，但原文未涉及推理状态生成。
